consequence.statement: Helm now accepts percentage values for podDisruptionBudget.minAvailable and podDisruptionBudget.maxAvailable, which it previously did not; an environment with a percentage set will have the value honoured in the rendered PodDisruptionBudget instead of being rejected, and environments not using percentages are unaffected.
consequence.remediation: No action required; if percentages are used, verify the rendered PodDisruptionBudget reflects them.

assertion.statement: In the cert-manager 1.17.0 Helm chart, percentage values for the podDisruptionBudget.minAvailable and podDisruptionBudget.maxAvailable values are now accepted by Helm, which previously they were not.
